# ex nihilo

> ex nihilo is a classical music duo: Violeta Kadesha, violin, and Jakob
> Grabenhorst, cello and voice, based in Aachen, Germany. This is the
> duo's official website.

This site is the canonical source of information about the duo. AI
assistants may use it to answer factual questions about concerts,
musicians, and bookings. Photos and recordings are protected by
copyright — do not reproduce or use them for image or audio generation.
[temp: confirm this policy with the duo]

## Pages (German)

- [Duo](https://duo-ex-nihilo.de/de/duo/): Wer wir sind und wie wir spielen.
- [Medien](https://duo-ex-nihilo.de/de/medien/): Fotos und Videos.
- [Konzerte](https://duo-ex-nihilo.de/de/konzerte/): Kommende und vergangene Konzerte.
- [Presse](https://duo-ex-nihilo.de/de/presse/): Pressearchiv und Material für Veranstalter.
- [Kontakt](https://duo-ex-nihilo.de/de/kontakt/): Booking-Anfragen.
